narration.say: Chicago tried to move the Bean seven inches. The Bean declined.
How many people would it actually take?
The real one is structurally supported, so imagine a loose Bean.
Assume friction resists half its weight, and each person pushes three hundred newtons.
That's four hundred ninety thousand newtons: about sixteen hundred perfectly coordinated people.
Perfectly is doing a lot of work.
Opposite pushes cancel. Angled ones only partly help. Most people can't reach it.
Seven inches is a distance, not the starting force.
The real Bean needs an anchoring calculation.
Chicago brought the squad. The Bean brought a foundation.
Follow Media Diet for the physics behind the headlines.
